maria g.: quick one — trying to finalize the telemetry & console UX for embedding requests that include file attachments. proposal: we don't store raw attachment bodies, but we keep a 64-bit fingerprint + embedding vector + sampling flag for any sampled PII snippets. thoughts? :thinking_face:

jamal: +1 to no raw bodies. what's the sampling rule tho? quota-aware? per-tenant? :eyes:

maria g.: plan: quota-aware sampler: prefer non-PII, but if route flagged high-risk, sample at higher rate for QA. store fingerprint as `sha256(base64)` prefix. include consent token when available.

kevin: we should avoid storing any reversible hashes. sha256 ok, but storing base64 of the hash in console still risky. suggest hmac with tenant key.

sophie: agree with kevin. also need escape hatch for legal requests — logs that can be exported to customer EDR only if tenant auths.

maria g.: good call — use HMAC-SHA256(tenant_k, attachment_bytes) -> hex. store as `attachment_fingerprint`.

ingest-bot: new PR opened: platform/telemetry#1423 for HMAC fingerprinting + sampler. link: https://git.internal/r/1423

```
# pseudo ingest flow
fingerprint = hmac_sha256(tenant_key, b64decode(attachment))
store { fingerprint_hex, embedding_vector, sampled: true/false }
```

jamal: UX question — in the console we show sampled snippets for redaction QA. do we show snippet or only redacted preview? we should NEVER show full raw.

kevin: only redacted preview. and always mask any detected PII with `<REDACTED:EMAIL>` style. small sample length cap 200 chars.

sophie: also add an opt-in debug mode per-tenant that can surface original snippet to SEs for debugging. gated and audited.

ops-oncall: must log who viewed that unredacted snippet and TTL for access. audit log + breakglass flow required.

maria g.: agreed. final question: embeddings storage — currently we dedup embeddings at ingest by fingerprint. if we HMAC per-tenant, dedupe becomes per-tenant. are we ok with that?

jamal: per-tenant dedupe may be fine; global dedupe is a privacy risk anyway.

kevin: plus dedup across tenants could leak info. go per-tenant.

sophie: analytics impact — per-tenant dedupe increases storage but fine. update billing docs.

maria g.: action items: 1) ingest team implement HMAC fingerprint (PR linked). 2) sampler: quota-aware rules + high-risk route override (jamal). 3) console: show only redacted preview; add breakglass audit mode (sophie). 4) update billing + docs (kevin). assign owners in PR.

jamal: I'll take sampler. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll update docs and billing note.

sophie: will mock console changes tomorrow.

maria g.: thanks — filing a short RFC with these decisions after stand. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: note for oncall: ensure breakglass alerts go to sec-snooze channel; will add runbook.

maria g.: nice. closing thread once RFC live.
